The club was founded in 2010 by the Târgoviște Municipality, together with former international [[Gheorghe Popescu (footballer, born 1967)|Gheorghe Popescu]] and former [[referee]] [[Ion Crăciunescu]], following a dispute with the owner of the city's former club, [[FCM Târgoviște]].{{cite web|url=https://www.fanatik.ro/liga-clonelor-cluburile-din-elita-romaniei-se-confrunta-mai-mult-ca-niciodata-cu-criza-de-identitate-19581988|title=Liga "clonelor"! Cluburile din elita României se confruntă mai mult ca niciodată cu criza de identitate|trans-title=League of "clones"! Romania's elite clubs are facing a bigger than ever identity crisis|publisher=Fanatik.ro|lang=ro|date=14 July 2021|accessdate=15 July 2021|quote=Chindia Târgoviște - founded in 2010, is not the successor of the former team from Târgoviște.|archive-date=27 January 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240127133050/https://www.fanatik.ro/liga-clonelor-cluburile-din-elita-romaniei-se-confrunta-mai-mult-ca-niciodata-cu-criza-de-identitate-19581988|url-status=live}} Chindia retained several elements associated with FCM, including its red and blue colours and the "[[Chindia Tower|Chindia]]" identity.{{cite web|url=https://theplaymaker.ro/fotbalul-din-turnul-chindiei-de-la-berile-cu-dobrin-pana-la-fcsb-vs-steaua-in-varianta-damboviteana/3812/|title=Fotbalul din Turnul Chindiei, de la berile cu Dobrin până la "FCSB vs. Steaua" în variantă dâmbovițeană|trans-title=Football from Chindia Tower, from the beers drunk with Dobrin to "FCSB vs. Steaua" in a Dâmbovița alternative|publisher=Theplaymaker.ro|lang=ro|date=8 October 2018|accessdate=20 May 2019|archive-date=13 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190713093706/https://theplaymaker.ro/fotbalul-din-turnul-chindiei-de-la-berile-cu-dobrin-pana-la-fcsb-vs-steaua-in-varianta-damboviteana/3812/|url-status=live}} The club first reached the Romanian top flight in [[2019–20 Liga I|2019–20]] and finished seventh in [[2020–21 Liga I|2020–21]]. It plays its home matches at the [[Stadionul Eugen Popescu|Eugen Popescu Stadium]], which reopened in 2023 after reconstruction."}}
